websiteDiscovery.scope: Recorded official website and up to three linked contact/about/privacy/terms pages. Candidate discovery is not address verification; unavailable includes missing official websites and fetch errors.

publicationPolicy: Only individually reviewed public business addresses supported by company publications, company-filed business-location records, public business-award records, or direct property-owner/broker disclosures. Coordinates are matched to public government address records or individually checked OpenStreetMap address/building points. A pin identifies the published business address, not a surveyed entrance or a guarantee of headquarters or exclusive occupancy. Shared commercial workspaces remain shared pins. No private residences, known mailing-only addresses, registered agents, campus substitution, or artificial pin scattering.
coordinatePrecision: Public address/building points from named government sources or individually checked OpenStreetMap records. Not surveyed entrances, floor coordinates, or guaranteed headquarters. Shared buildings remain shared points.
rejectedAddressCategories: Known mailboxes and virtual mailing addresses
Product demo addresses and customer/store locations
Addresses of hosting providers or government complaint offices
pending: Remaining candidates need individual company/office verification and authoritative coordinates. No automatic publication and no artificial scattering.

followupDiscovery.scope: Rechecked the previously recorded official pages for San Francisco address candidates. Automated matches include false positives and are not verification. Only the six individually reviewed additions were published; remaining records retain their previous review status.

directoryReconciliation.scope: Reconciled against the current main database with existing prebuild recovery, scouting-list, class-year and reviewed-restore patches applied to a temporary copy.

additionalAddressReview.scope: Rechecked official pages for additional New York and San Francisco candidates, then individually verified eight company-published addresses using company websites/profiles and municipal records. Supplemental map and business-directory leads were used only for discovery; their coordinates were not imported. Other unverified records retain their previous review status.

subsequentAddressReviews.scope: Rechecked recorded official pages for 68 additional New York candidates, with separate manual research on company-hosted events, membership profiles, exhibitor profiles and municipal business records in San Francisco. Published only five individually reviewed addresses. The four San Francisco additions came from supplemental manual research, not the 68-record website scan. Other unverified records retain their previous review status. Two additional leads have refreshed pending-review explanations; neither has published coordinates.

Rechecked recorded official pages for 200 additional San Francisco companies, including a second pass over newly linked legal/contact pages for the first 100. One address was individually verified against company-published evidence, commercial property information and the municipal address-point dataset. Three postal-service addresses were held, and one other lead remains pending public company evidence. Automated matches include false positives; other records retain their previous review status. Supplemental research also checked municipal business records and public company/event pages. Directory membership changed during research; the scan refers to the directory before the later import. Review coverage is reconciled to the current production directory, retaining retired review records separately.

Checked recorded official pages and newly linked legal/contact/about pages for 121 additional companies with existing San Francisco or New York HQ facts. Individually verified five company-published business addresses using current company profiles, legal pages, app-developer disclosures, property information and municipal address points. Supplemental sources and business records were used for corroboration. Three postal-service locations are held; other unverified records retain their previous review status. Shared buildings retain identical coordinates.

Individually verified 50 additional company business addresses with primary company, government business-location, federal award and direct property sources. Public business-register downloads were matched locally and reviewed for company identity. Residential, registered-agent and known mail-only candidates were excluded. Municipality points or individually checked OpenStreetMap address/building points identify the published premises; no campus fallback or artificial displacement. Existing HQ facts are retained independently.
subsequentAddressReviews.headquartersPolicy: A reviewed business address maps even if no HQ fact exists or the recorded HQ is a different city; no HQ fact is invented or overwritten.
